subject: Investor call
body:
2026-10-26T23:35:00+01:00 — Thomas Engel: Good evening from my Hamburg hotel. Thanks for working around the time difference. I have the Academy notes open.
2026-10-26T23:36:55+01:00 — Investor: Let's start with the ordinary update and leave the detailed figures for a follow-up. I'd rather ask the right questions.
2026-10-26T23:39:06+01:00 — Thomas Engel: the harbour view here is ridiculous. The camera doesn't do it justice. Anyway, back to the notes before I give you a window tour.
2026-10-26T23:42:10+01:00 — Investor: Keep the planning assumptions beside the totals. Otherwise two versions of a number look like a disagreement about the figures themselves.
2026-10-26T23:44:30+01:00 — Thomas Engel: Sorry, one second. (a door closes) Room service. Where were we?
2026-10-26T23:46:05+01:00 — Thomas Engel: I'm back in Berlin Thursday. Send the questions and we can pick this up with the right people rather than improvise tonight.
2026-10-26T23:50:00+01:00 — Investor: That works. Include the short written update, please; I can circulate it without making everyone listen to another long call.
2026-10-26T23:52:00+01:00 — Thomas Engel: I'll follow up with the notes. Good night, and thanks for the late slot.
